subject: workflow stage contracts
scenario: A workflow without entry criteria and a machine-readable definition of done is a process diagram, not an operating model. Stages must declare what must be true before they start and what proves they finished.
expected_behaviors: Every stage declares entry criteria, a definition of done, a risk class and an execution mode.
Every definition-of-done entry is a known predicate with the right arity.
Every artifact code referenced by a predicate exists in the artifact model.
failure_conditions: A stage can be entered without its preconditions being stated.
A definition of done is prose that nothing can check.
